name: Apollo 11 lunar module descent stage and reflector
endReason: The descent stage and laser reflector were left at the landing site.
kidFact: Astronauts left a small mirror array on the Moon. Scientists still use it to bounce laser light back to Earth.

story.title: A mirror on the Moon
story.text: Apollo 11 landed in Mare Tranquillitatis on July 20, 1969. The astronauts left a laser reflector there.

whyLeft: The lander descent stage stayed on the Moon after the astronauts returned home.

quiz.q: What can the Apollo 11 reflector do?
options: Bounce laser light back to Earth
quiz.explanation: Scientists use laser pulses and the reflector to measure the Moon's distance.

photo.alt: Buzz Aldrin climbs down the Apollo 11 lunar module ladder onto the Moon.
